text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Now, the curtain is finally lifting on the 
URA Finals!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
This is the dream stage where the star 
horse girls of the Twinkle series compete 
for the top spot!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm pleased to announce our 
illustrious runners! First up—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey hey, did you see what's trending!? 
It's almost exclusively URA Finals 
runners!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The hype's really building! Hey, hey, who 
do you have your eye on?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Fan A
text_block_list.text: Haha, let's say it together! One, Two—

<chrname> has been recognized for her spectacular 
achievements thus far.

And accepted to participate in the grand 
tournament where star Uma Musume gather, 
the URA Finals!

I'll get <chrname> through the qualifyiers and aim 
to win the whole thing!
